title: 18078 - 18078/P1670
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or connections to/from the Valve for Pump Jet
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  wiring and Kontrol edin:  / Temizleyin:  all connections
Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  the cable-tree to/from all the Valves for Pump Jet
Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Valve for Pump Jet (Değiştirin / Yenileyin: them all !)
technicalNotes: For each Valve the ECU checks the Begin of Injection Period (BIP) via a voltage. That voltage is very small (less than 0.0001A). Each extra resistance in the cable is fatal. So, in case of any doubt, just Değiştirin / Yenileyin: all cables.
